findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: data__search_address · Private data: data__search_listed_companies, data__search_company, data__get_company_profile, migawari__get_task_status, migawari__get_evidence, migawari__cancel_task · Public sink: data__lookup_postcode, data__search_address, migawari__list_services, migawari__send_message · Destructive: data__validate_corporate_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: data__search_address · Private data: data__search_listed_companies, data__search_company, data__get_company_profile, migawari__get_task_status, migawari__get_evidence, migawari__cancel_task · Public sink: data__lookup_postcode, data__search_address, migawari__list_services, migawari__send_message · Destructive: data__validate_corporate_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
